author: claude
summary: Task 002 of the voice-variant version-history plan: wires the already-landed app/domain/voices/variant_versions.py snapshot mechanics into the build endpoint. Before build_speaker_profile clears the existing sample.wav/sample.mp3 to rebuild a variant, it now calls snapshot_current_as_version to record the outgoing live state (sample.mp3 + engine/test_text/settings) as a version, so rebuilding a voice no longer silently discards its prior sample. The snapshot call is wrapped in try/except Exception (logged, never raised) so a version-history failure can never block a rebuild -- this ordering/isolation is the invariant this task exists to enforce.

files.change: In build_speaker_profile, inside the existing containment-checked branch (resolved_pdir.startswith(trusted_voices_root + os.sep)), inserted a call to snapshot_current_as_version(Path(resolved_pdir), engine_id=..., test_text=..., voice_job_settings=spk_settings) BEFORE the pre-existing sample.wav/sample.mp3 delete loop, wrapped in try/except Exception -> logger.exception (never surfaces to the caller). No other logic in the function changed.

Added test_build_snapshots_previous_sample_as_version: seeds a variant with a live sample.mp3 + engine/test_text settings, calls the /build endpoint (orchestrator submit mocked, as in existing build tests), and asserts versions/versions.json now has exactly one entry whose versions/<id>/artifact.mp3 byte-matches the pre-build sample.mp3, and that the live sample.mp3 was cleared. R1 revert-check performed manually (temporarily replaced the snapshot try block with a no-op, confirmed this test fails on missing versions.json, restored the code, confirmed it passes again) -- not committed as a separate artifact, per the task's verification step.
